refinement.detail: SEARCHED, AND A REAL REDUCTION WAS FOUND AND DELIBERATELY NOT TAKEN, which is recorded here rather than reported as "none" because "none" would be false. The execution mode CA-06 deleted (CA-06-DF-03) leaves TWO NOW-DEAD PORTS declared in the model: `case_program_process` (process.spawn, `*programs/case-*`) and `case_program_write` (filesystem.write, `**/programs/case-*`), both listed under RunSpecUnitTests, both @port annotated at TlaSpecDevCli.tla:506 and :509, in all three spec trees. The effects they declare CAN NO LONGER OCCUR, so removing them is a genuine reduction of declared model surface and it needs NO TLC -- a port declaration is not a variable, an action or a bound. NOT TAKEN HERE for one stated reason: tests/test_port_declarations.py:136 asserts `case_program_process` BY NAME, so it is a model change WITH a test to update, and it was discovered at review time on an already-open PR. Enumerated exactly in CA-06-DF-03's blast_radius -- 2 manifest port blocks x 3 trees, 2 @port annotations x 3 trees, 1 RunSpecUnitTests list entry x 3 trees, 3 citation comments x 3 trees, plus the test row -- so the next ticket takes it without rediscovering it. THE REFINEMENT THAT WAS TAKEN is generator-side rather than model-side and is a SUBTRACTION: resolve_next_relation deletes a hardcoded "Next" in favour of find_next_relation, which scripts/analyze_complexity.py has shipped for three epics and this module never called. It removes a special case instead of adding one, and it is a byte-level no-op on both models that already worked, so no sealed corpus and no TLC figure moves.

kill_rate.evidence: scripts/kill_test.py's oracle-4 half was removed by CA-04 (RM-03-DF-05), so this repository has no mutation-kill instrument to run. CA-06 measured kills on a DIFFERENT subject with its own probe -- specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/CA-06/mutation_probe.py -- and that is NOT this member and is not recorded as it.

behavior_tests.evidence: specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/CA-06/pytest-promotion.txt -- full suite at the merged tip. READ THE FILE, NOT THIS WORD: the suite carries 8 inherited and deliberate reds at this epic's baseline and this run reproduces exactly that set, item for item, with nothing attributable to CA-06. `pass` here means `matches the declared baseline`, which is the only sense in which this suite passes for anyone.

The descriptor comparison is DEGENERATE BY CONSTRUCTION at direction=zero: before and after are the same model.

ticket.model_delta_expectation: POSSIBLE AND ACCEPTABLE. Simplification may reduce generated case surface. Record the delta in specs/current and the desired model and say what changed.
ticket.objective: THE OWNER'S DIRECTION, AND THE TENSION IS TO BE NOTED HONESTLY RATHER THAN QUIETLY RESOLVED EITHER WAY. The owner keeps this path: 'I do want to keep parts of the TLA+ diagram, I still think generating cases, using adapters is valid, I want to make it dead simple, the regressions should tried to be included in TLA+ and adapters in the most simple validated way.' TAKE THAT AS A DECISION. And state the tension plainly in your PR: THE MEASUREMENT SAYS THE CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION DOES NOT BEAT HAND-WRITTEN TESTS -- 0 unique kills against 4 the other way, replicated on new subjects -- while the direction is to keep it and shrink it. THOSE ARE COMPATIBLE ONLY IF IT GETS DRAMATICALLY SMALLER. generate_cases_from_tlc_dump.py (3,471) plus run_generated_case_adapters.py (2,455) is ~5,900 LINES PRODUCING A CORPUS WITH ZERO UNIQUE KILLS. THE TARGET IS NOT DELETION -- it is a version small enough that its yield is worth its size and simple enough that AN ADOPTER COULD RUN IT. SIMPLIFY AGGRESSIVELY; DO NOT DELETE. Keep the shape the owner named: a TLA+ action or an adapter conformance case is how a regression gets expressed, and SV-04 ALREADY DEMONSTRATED THE ADAPTER HALF -- a 14-case conformance suite with durability asserted OUT OF BAND moved D3 from 3 to 4 against a control. REPORT WHAT THE SIMPLIFIED VERSION COSTS AND WHAT IT CATCHES, on a real subject. IF THE SIMPLIFIED VERSION STILL YIELDS ZERO UNIQUE KILLS, SAY SO -- THAT IS A RESULT, and the owner's direction was to simplify it, not to prove it works. MF-020 applies with force here: do not fit a case, an axis or a corpus to a bug you already know about.
ticket.title: Make the TLA+ / case-generation / adapter path dead simple -- and report what the simplified version costs and catches
